description: Structured compliance audit results for a privacy policy, evaluated only against the provided corporate standards.

audit_results.description: Per-requirement audit findings. Each key is a named requirement area and maps to one compliance finding.

DPO_CONTACT.description: Assessment of whether the policy satisfies the corporate standard requirements for DPO or privacy contact information.

standard_evidence.description: Exact excerpt quoted from the CORPORATE STANDARDS that defines the requirement. If unavailable, write: "No matching standard text found".

policy_evidence.description: Exact excerpt quoted from the PRIVACY POLICY CONTENT that addresses the requirement. If missing, write: "No matching policy text found".

status.description: Compliance classification for this requirement, determined only by comparing the policy to the corporate standards.

remediation.description: Minimal, precise remediation aligned to the corporate standard. Use an empty string when status is Compliant or Not Applicable.
